notes: FirstSeen Desktop V10.2.14 bundles Browser CRM V2.9 and replaces the existing cold-call script with the latest FirstSeen cold-call delivery guide. The new guide includes delivery cues for pace and pauses, the full objection flow, No Answer / Voicemail, and Delivery Rules, while keeping lead-specific business name, call reason, website issue, business summary and review snapshot integration. The replacement guide uses a fresh script-save namespace so older saved templates do not override it; previous saved data remains untouched in the old namespace. Existing script editing/saving, Twilio browser calling, outcomes, follow-ups, Finder shortlist, SQLite CRM data and updater behaviour are preserved.
